notes.title: Writers block and animations
notes.content:
I want to thank everyone for their patience, and do apologize for disappearing for a month and half when i said a week and not saying anything.

Female route is coming this weekend, and ill have the rest of the day out asap.

For where i have been, between irl things and a struggle I was having on the female route, my brain decided to take time off without asking me.
For the issue i was having with the female route, if you play the male route, you know that Jackie has a very specific and emotional story around the male mc.
I was struggling to find, even close to the equivalent for the female route, and i wrote, and wrote, and wrote their conversations, over and over again with different ideas and nothing felt right.
So.. writers block essentially.
I have it now, finally. So just finishing that up and getting the code ready and double checking a few things.

I know i should have said something sooner, i just, don't handle things like this well, I hate to disappoint, even though I know not saying anything is worse. and i become more anti social then i already am, and its not like i was just not saying anything here, i haven't really talked to anyone in over a month.

but wasn't wasted time. While writing that over and over again, i was also working on a element for day 8 that revolves around Ava, a very rather complicated scene I wasn't sure I could do, but its why i started it so early.
I figured out how, and i learned some new things that's going to change how I do animations from this point forward.
Working with animations in daz studio isn't the easiest thing, which is why, most of the animations are loops.
I needed to make a very detailed, and linear animation that's over 3 minutes long, and i figured out how to do it in a timely fashion, and had the first 20 seconds created in about 3 hours once i figured it out, and very quickly realized i can apply that same technique to all animations moving forward.
Meaning, much more linear and detailed animations in the future, and even reworking a few planned for the end of day 7, as well as one that hasn't been included on the male route earlier in day 7.

So, thanks again, and i do apologize, female route this weekend. And pushing to get these animations reworked and done so i can complete day 7 by the end of the month.

notes.title: 01/14/2024 Progress Report
notes.content:
The morning is mostly done, all that is really left to do for morning content is finish a bunch of queued animation renders.

I am working on PM renders right now, The afternoon and night for day 6 was a bit of a process, I knew what I wanted to do, but had no idea how to pull it off in Daz studio.

Daz doesn't like it when scenes get too large. And they are large. But was able to get it figured out and working without Daz freaking out on me. Trying to work in a big open area with a lot of props, buildings and people is a bit much for daz, but its working.



Other info - The house in day 6.

As most of you know, I have worked on increasing the quality of character shaders and skin design since the start of all this, while trying to avoid drastic jumps in changes in each day so its not a big noticeable difference. I think the skin is looking real good now, but it had a side effect.

While rendering in the house in day 6, the new character shaders and lighting just didn't fit and/or work well in the house how it was. I have wanted to redo sections of the house since the start of this, and upgrade its shaders, but some issues with the way the house was built made this a bit difficult, from 45 degree texture maps to random textures inside the house being linked to textures outside the house, Its a nice house, just doesn't do well when being upgraded or enhanced.

So since we haven't been in the house since halfway through day 4, if the house is going to be fixed, it was going to be now, So I did.

The house has a yard now, and neighbors, and grass... grass.. that was fun..

The walls have been upgraded with much better shaders, I spent way to long making a good drywall shader, I had some fun with stable diffusion creating new art for the walls.

While the kitchen layout is the same, the fridge area has been redone, The original fridge, cabinets, stove, etc. didn't actually function so we couldn't open the fridge, now we can, same with cabinets and the oven.

And the yard is a yard, pool is now visible from the house, I don't know if anyone noticed before but the pool and house were disconnected, the house's original yard was to small to support a pool.

so yeah, all that happened, I hope the almost 2 days away from the house in game will make this change less jarring, but it looks so much better, to me anyways ;).

Of course, all this happened after I already started rendering in the house, so I did have to rerender a good 200 images, but that's already done and past now, all in all, with the rerenders and house rebuild, it took about a week, so not to bad.

notes.title: Day 6 Progress report

Day 6 is progressing at a decent pace. A little over 1000 finalized renders for day 6 that take it to about mid day, However there is a lot of animations still rendering for the first part of the day.

To give an idea of what to expect in day 6 in terms of Ero content.

Male Route:  Mei (Full Ero Content, Multiple choices.), Kayla (Mild Ero content, Multiple Choices), Ava (Full Ero Content, Multiple Choices), Alex (Not entirely sure yet, as that's later in the day, but there will be a lot of options/choices)

Female Route:  Kayla (Full Ero Content, Multiple Choices.) Ava (Kind of mild, Kind of full, Multiple Choices.) Alex (Again, Later in the day, But expect some good amount here as well.)

It is also possible that an alternate path will show up in day 6, however I am waiting to complete more of day 6's primary path before i work to much on it so it doesn't delay day 6 primary, but its looking good. This path directly involves Ava, With some side effects for both Alex(Alex's side effect is pretty intense at first) and Kayla, it is avoidable, and will have a warning when its triggered as its Ava's dark path, it's also the first trigger for "goth" Ava, There will be other goth triggers for Ava, so if you want goth Ava without the dark path, that will still be possible.

It is the first major alternate path, and I just want to make sure I can do it in a timely manner as it will have a pretty large effect for a few days in the story, resulting in scenes and content that are only available on that path, and will require some form of alterations for the remainder of the story.
